fields.label: Staging-Only Program
fields.name: staging_only
fields.instructions: When enabled, this program is hidden on the live production site (teonox.com) and only appears on staging (hostingersite.com) / localhost. Use this to test unreleased V2 programs without exposing them publicly. The frontend also treats any slug ending in -v2 as staging-only for safety.

fields.label: Card Duration
fields.name: card_duration
fields.instructions: Short duration/commitment text shown on the program listing card (e.g. "6 Months | 4 Capstone Projects").

fields.label: Card Certifications
fields.name: card_certifications
fields.instructions: Short certification/badge line shown on the program listing card (e.g. "Official Certification from TEONOX & Google").

fields.label: Card Designed For
fields.name: card_designed_for
fields.instructions: Short target-audience line shown on the program listing card (e.g. "Designed for Graduates, Career Switchers & Founders").

fields.label: Card Brochure URL
fields.name: card_brochure_url
fields.instructions: Link to the downloadable brochure PDF used by the card's Brochure button.

fields.label: Hero Image
fields.name: hero_image
fields.instructions: Upload from the WordPress Media Library (Library: All). This image is authoritative and instantly and consistently updates BOTH the program card image and the detail page hero banner. Resolution order on the frontend: 1) this ACF Hero Image (object, URL, or media ID all supported) -> 2) the standard Featured Image -> 3) static graphic fallback. No other field is required.

fields.label: Designed For Image
fields.name: designed_for_image
fields.instructions: Optional image shown in the 'THIS COURSE IS DESIGNED FOR' section. Upload from the WordPress Media Library. Strictly dynamic (no static fallback): if left empty, the frontend renders an empty container. Prefer uniformly sized, high-quality images.

fields.label: Designed For Intro
fields.name: designed_for_intro
fields.instructions: Section introduction paragraph shown above the audience list in the 'THIS COURSE IS DESIGNED FOR' section (e.g. 'The program is suitable for learners at different stages of their career or business journey.'). Leave empty to hide it entirely.

sub_fields.label: Reason Title (Bold Prefix)
sub_fields.name: reason_title_bold
sub_fields.instructions: Bold prefix / headline for this reason (e.g. 'Understand how algorithms influence growth'). Optional.

sub_fields.label: Reason Text
sub_fields.name: reason_text
sub_fields.instructions: Inline non-bold description text that follows the bold title. Leave empty to show only the title.

sub_fields.label: Outcome Lead In Bold
sub_fields.name: outcome_lead_in_bold
sub_fields.instructions: Bold lead-in paragraph for the outcomes section (e.g. 'Depending on the projects and modules completed, learners will develop capabilities to:'). Leave empty to hide it entirely.

fields.label: Value Bold Paragraph 1
fields.name: value_bold_paragraph_1
fields.instructions: Styled as the first bold paragraph in the 'VALUE OF THIS COURSE' section (e.g. 'The value of the program lies in...'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Value Body Paragraph
fields.name: value_body_paragraph
fields.instructions: Regular body text paragraph (e.g. 'A learner could study SEO, Google Ads, WordPress, Analytics, Copywriting and AI separately...'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Value Bold Paragraph 2
fields.name: value_bold_paragraph_2
fields.instructions: Styled as the second bold paragraph (e.g. 'A professional needs to understand how these disciplines connect.'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Value Grey Paragraph
fields.name: value_grey_paragraph
fields.instructions: Styled as the light grey paragraph (e.g. 'The program is designed around this broader perspective.'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Value Highlight Orange Bold
fields.name: value_highlight_orange_bold
fields.instructions: Styled as the orange bold callout paragraph (e.g. 'That shift from tool operator to marketing thinker is one of the core values of the program.'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Value Proposition (Legacy Fallback)
fields.name: value_proposition
fields.instructions: Legacy fallback used when 'Value Bold Paragraph 1' is empty. Prefer 'Value Bold Paragraph 1'.

fields.label: Certifications Intro
fields.name: certifications_intro
fields.instructions: Intro paragraph for the 'CERTIFICATIONS INCLUDED' section (e.g. 'The program can combine a TEONOX Program Certification with preparation for relevant platform certifications...'). Leave empty to hide it.

fields.label: Certifications Pathways Lead In
fields.name: certifications_pathways_lead_in
fields.instructions: Bold lead-in rendered above the certification cards (e.g. 'Certification pathways may include areas such as:'). Leave empty to omit.

fields.label: Certifications Important Title
fields.name: certifications_important_title
fields.instructions: Bold title for the 'Important' information box in the certifications section (e.g. 'Important:'). Leave empty to omit the title.

fields.label: Certifications Important Text
fields.name: certifications_important_text
fields.instructions: Body paragraph for the 'Important' box (e.g. 'Third-party certifications are subject to the respective provider's current availability, eligibility requirements, examination process and policies.'). Leave empty to omit.

sub_fields.label: Internships Intro Text
sub_fields.name: opportunities_internships_intro
sub_fields.instructions: Intro paragraph for the Internship tab (e.g. 'Internships can help learners bridge the gap between classroom learning and actual execution.'). Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Internships Lead In Bold
sub_fields.name: opportunities_internships_lead_in_bold
sub_fields.instructions: Bold lead-in for the Internship tab (e.g. 'Depending on availability and eligibility, learners may receive opportunities through:'). Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Freelancing Intro Text
sub_fields.name: opportunities_freelancing_intro
sub_fields.instructions: Intro paragraph for the Freelancing tab (e.g. 'Digital Marketing provides multiple opportunities to build an independent professional career.'). Leave empty to hide.

sub_fields.label: Freelancing Lead In Bold
sub_fields.name: opportunities_freelancing_lead_in_bold
sub_fields.instructions: Bold lead-in for the Freelancing tab (e.g. 'Students can explore services such as:'). Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: CTA Banner
fields.instructions: Bottom call-to-action banner ('Ready to Start Your Digital Marketing Journey?'). Every element is dynamic: leave a field empty to fall back to its default copy.

fields.label: CTA Title
fields.name: cta_title
fields.instructions: Headline string shown in the bottom CTA banner (e.g. 'Ready to Start Your Digital Marketing Journey?'). Leave empty to use the default.

fields.label: CTA Description
fields.name: cta_description
fields.instructions: Body description text in the bottom CTA banner. Leave empty to use the default.

fields.label: CTA Image
fields.name: cta_image
fields.instructions: Left person/counsellor image shown in the bottom CTA banner. Upload from the WordPress Media Library. Leave empty to use the default counsellor image.

fields.label: CTA Primary Button Text
fields.name: cta_primary_button_text
fields.instructions: Primary button label (e.g. 'Apply Now'). Leave empty to use the default.

fields.label: CTA Primary Button URL
fields.name: cta_primary_button_url
fields.instructions: Primary button link/action (e.g. '/apply' or 'mailto:admissions@teonox.com'). Leave empty to keep the default enquiry behaviour.

fields.label: CTA Secondary Button Text
fields.name: cta_secondary_button_text
fields.instructions: Secondary button label (e.g. 'Talk to Career Advisor'). Leave empty to use the default.

fields.label: CTA Secondary Button URL
fields.name: cta_secondary_button_url
fields.instructions: Secondary button link/action (e.g. '/contact'). Leave empty to keep the default enquiry behaviour.

fields.label: CTA Brand Tagline
fields.name: cta_brand_tagline
fields.instructions: Bottom tagline (e.g. 'TEONOX | Learn. Apply. Lead.'). Leave empty to use the default.
